Convergence.MentorDef.label: Elder Yun Shouzhi
Convergence.MentorDef.description: A retired Sword Elder of the Formless Sword who traded his sword for a hoe. He held the torn guardian formation of his sect during the Convergence and was thrown across the rift.

li.label: a place to breathe
li.description: "Qi does not come to those who chase it. Build a place to sit and wait for it." Build a cultivation cushion.

li.label: listen to the qi
li.description: "Slow is smooth. Smooth is fast." Any disciple must advance one stage while Elder Yun watches: by cultivating qi on a cushion, or by tempering the body with spirit-beast blood.

li.label: the first technique
li.description: "Do not draw it if you will not finish it." Elder Yun hands over a jade slip. Any disciple must learn a new technique.

Convergence.MentorDef.arrivalWalkerText:
An old man sits by the road, watering a potted plant that was not there a moment ago. His robe is plain, his hands calloused, and the air around him is so still that birds land on his shoulders.

"I am thirsty, I am hungry and I am in no hurry," says {PAWN_nameDef}. "Your world just woke up. You will need someone to teach you how to breathe."

Elder Yun joins the colony.
Convergence.MentorDef.arrivalWoundedText: Blue flames streak across the sky and something crashes beyond the fields. In the crater lies an old man in a torn robe, a broken hoe still in his hand: {PAWN_nameDef}, thrown across the rift by the Convergence.\n\nHe is badly hurt. Rescue him and let him heal: when he can stand, he will teach the colony.
Convergence.MentorDef.protectionText:
Cultivators have come for the colony. {PAWN_nameDef} sets down his watering pot and steps to the front.

"There. Behind the hedge. Don't shout. Watch, and learn."

For a day, the Elder fights with the full strength of a Nascent Soul.
Convergence.MentorDef.farewellText:
One morning a sword-light crosses the sky above the colony: the Formless Sword calls its Elder home.

"Water the pot. That's all. That's the whole sect," says {PAWN_nameDef}, picks up his hoe and walks out through the gate toward the mountains, without looking back.

Where he stood lies a leaf of green jade. It is warm, and sometimes it seems to whisper.
Convergence.MentorDef.deathText: {PAWN_nameDef} has fallen. As his body cools, his soul flees into the jade he always wore; a fragment breaks off and stays with the colony, still warm.

HediffDef.label: qi exhaustion
HediffDef.description: His dantian is empty: he spent every drop of qi holding his body together through the rift. He will not wake until some of it comes back.

HediffDef.label: Nascent Soul presence
HediffDef.description: A master of the Nascent Soul realm, only half-bound to this world. Hard to hurt, quick and strong; needs little food or rest and keeps a calm heart.

HediffDef.label: guardian's resolve
HediffDef.description: The master fights to protect the colony with all the strength of a Nascent Soul. A master who arrived wounded with the Convergence repays shelter the old way: with the sword. While the colony is in danger, the master holds nothing back.

ThingDef.label: leaf of the peak
ThingDef.description: A leaf of green jade, broken from the pendant of Elder Yun Shouzhi. It is always warm. Sometimes it seems to whisper: "it grows where the water is clean", "it smells of cut grass", "it burns blue when the Peak is near".\n\nOne day it will lead the colony to its master.
